heroSub: FiveStar AI designs and builds every kind of software—mobile, web, desktop, backend, and AI—using LLMs to work across programming languages and technology stacks.
aboutLead: We are an AI-native software company with deep experience in LLM-powered development. We turn business problems into reliable products without being limited by a specific programming language, platform, or technology stack.
missionBody: We use AI and LLMs to choose the right tools for each problem and deliver across technology stacks.
principlesBody: AI accelerates the work; our engineers remain accountable for architecture, quality, security, and results.
focusBody: Mobile, web, desktop, backend, AI agents, data systems, and workflow automation.
productsLead: Our products show how we take ideas to launch across AI, mobile, documents, media, and productivity software.
p1: OCR workflow para sa mga na-scan na dokumento: extract, search, summarize, TTS—privacy-forward gamit ang local processing.
p2: Fast, simple local media player with no ads and a smooth experience across mobile platforms.
p4: Software na nagsasama sa local AI para magbigay-daan sa distributed processing at mga pribadong pag-uusap.
p5: Gawing madali ang pagsasalin at localization ng mga App Store screenshot sa iba't ibang wika para sa submission.
p6: Consent-based na nearby chat sa pamamagitan ng Bluetooth na may optional na lokal na AI translation. Walang account, walang central chat server.
p7: Location-aware na pass manager. Ipinapakita ang tamang coupon o membership card sa sandaling dumating ka.
p3: From internal systems and web services to mobile, desktop, and AI products. We choose the best language and stack for each problem.
servicesLead: LLM-accelerated engineering turns a clearly defined problem into working software faster.
s1Body: Define the business goal, users, constraints, and the right technical approach.
s2Body: Use LLM-assisted engineering to design, implement, test, and iterate across platforms.
s3Body: Deploy, monitor, operate, and continuously improve the product.
